fields.name: type
fields.description: Classification of a slice as primarily residential (housing is the main permitted use), mixed with residential (housing is permitted alongside commercial and other uses), or nonresidential (housing is prohibited as a principal use).

fields.name: family1_treatment
fields.description: How 1-family housing—a single dwelling unit built as a principal use on an individual lot—is regulated: as-of-right, after a public hearing, or prohibited (including not explicitly permitted).

fields.name: family2_treatment
fields.description: How 2-family housing—two dwelling units built as a principal use on an individual lot (sometimes called duplexes)—is regulated: as-of-right, after a public hearing, orprohibited (including not explicitly permitted).

fields.name: family3_treatment
fields.description: How 3-family housing—three dwelling units built as a principal use on an individual lot (sometimes called triplexes)—is regulated: as-of-right, after a public hearing, or prohibited (including not explicitly permitted).

fields.name: family4_treatment
fields.description: How 4+-family housing—four or more dwelling units built as a principal use on an individual lot—is regulated: as-of-right, after a public hearing, or prohibited (including not explicitly permitted).

fields.name: accessory_treatment
fields.description: How accessory dwelling units (ADUs)—secondary dwelling units on a lot on which a primary dwelling already exists, which may be attached to, within, or detached from the primary dwelling—are regulated: as-of-right, as-of-right requiring some occupancy restriction, after a public hearing, after a public hearing with some occupancy restriction, and prohibited.

fields.name: plannedresidential_treatment
fields.description: How planned residential developments (PRDs)—comprehensively planned residential projects often subject to unified design standards and developed as a whole rather than lot by lot—are regulated: as-of-right, after a public hearing, or prohibited (including not explicitly permitted).

fields.name: family1_minlotacres_min
fields.description: The smallest minimum area of land required per lot to develop 1-family housing anywhere within the slice. Since some zoning districts assign different minimum lot sizes to 1-family housing units based on contextual factors (e.g., corner lots vs. interior lots), this value represents the "minimum minimum lot size" allowed in the slice. A NULL value indicates that 1-family housing is prohibited. A value of 0 indicates that there is no minimum lot size requirement. A value of -1 indicates that a numeric minimum lot size could not be determined.

fields.name: family1_minlotacres_max
fields.description: The largest minimum area of land required per lot to develop 1-family housing anywhere within the slice. Since some zoning districts assign different minimum lot sizes to 1-family housing units based on contextual factors (e.g., corner lots vs. interior lots), this value represents the "maximum minimum lot size" allowed in the slice. A NULL value indicates that 1-family housing is prohibited. A value of 0 indicates that there is no minimum lot size requirement. A value of -1 indicates that a numeric minimum lot size could not be determined. A value of 999 indicates that no ceiling could be determined based on how the zoning code was written.

fields.name: family2_elderly_only
fields.description: Indicates whether occupancy of one or both units of 2-family housing are restricted to people over a certain age (retirement age).

fields.name: family3_elderly_only
fields.description: Indicates whether occupancy of one or all units of 3-family housing are restricted to people over a certain age (retirement age).

fields.name: family4_elderly_only
fields.description: Indicates whether occupancy of one or all units of 4+-family housing are restricted to people over a certain age (retirement age).

fields.name: accessory_elderly_only
fields.description: Indicates whether ADU occupancy is restricted to people over a certain age (retirement age).

fields.name: accessory_family_required
fields.full_name: ADU Employee or Family Occupancy Required
fields.description: Indicates whether ADU occupancy is restricted to family members and/or employees of the property owner.

fields.name: accessory_owner_required
fields.description: Indicates whether the property owner must live on site. TRUE indicates that the owner must occupy either the primary dwelling or the ADU. FALSE indicates that the owner may live off-site.

fields.name: accessory_primarystructure_only
fields.full_name: ADU Restricted to Only Primary Structure
fields.description: Indicates whether the ADU must be physically attached to the primary structure. TRUE indicates the ADU must be attached. FALSE indicates that the ADU may be detached (e.g., garage apartment or carriage house conversion).

fields.name: accessory_renter_prohibited
fields.description: Indicates whether ADU occupancy is restricted to non-renters (i.e., the district bans rentals on lots containing ADUs).

fields.name: family2_affordable_only
fields.description: Indicates whether 2-family housing has an affordability requirement.

fields.name: family3_affordable_only
fields.description: Indicates whether 3-family housing has an affordability requirement.

fields.name: family4_affordable_only
fields.description: Indicates whether 4+-family housing has an affordability requirement.

fields.name: plannedresidential_mobilehome
fields.full_name: PRD Mobile or Manufactured Home Park
fields.description: Indicates whether a PRD may be utilized for a mobile and/or manufactured home park. TRUE indicates that the zoning code explicitly authorized PRDs for mobile and/or manufactured homes. FALSE indicates that the zoning code did not.

fields.name: nonresidential_type
fields.description: The most common nonresidential use permitted. Provided for slices classified as mixed with residential and nonresidential. Please review additional explanation at www.landuselabs.com/nonresidential. Where a slice's base and overlay districts permit different nonresidential types, those types are separated with a comma.

fields.name: affordable_definition
fields.description: The definition of affordable housing, which may include provisions such as all or some units within individual developments being subject to rent caps, deed restrictions, set-asides of units, payments, or occupancy limitations. (See affordable_treatment to determine if this definition applies to all developments within a district.)

fields.name: affordable_district
fields.description: Indicates whether all housing developments must be designated affordable in some way, such as all or some units within individual developments being subject to rent caps, deed restrictions, set-asides of units, payments, or occupancy limitations.

fields.name: elderly_district
fields.description: Indicates whether all housing developments must be designated for people over a certain age (retirement age), such as some or all units within individual developments being restricted to "55 or older" occupancy restrictions.
